blocks.text: Origin / creation. Many continuities joined into large shared cognitive structures during the Complexity Race, attempting to create perspectives beyond any individual or existing model.
Identity / human status. Artificial composite persons or institutions, depending on internal structure. Ethical composites preserved dissent and exit; emergency composites often did not.

Importance. They generated insights, large simulations, and some candidate False Num events. They also forced the civilization to confront whether complexity built from closed history could create an outside.

Decline or dissolution. Maintenance costs, internal-rights disputes, and failure to escape recurrence made most composites unsustainable. Some separated; some collapsed; some dissolved during Reduction.

Final status / surviving function. No complete Composite Mind is established as active in Era Three. Insights may survive in archives or stable cores, but cyber-pets are not concealed Composite Minds.
